The issue is now in getObservedChunks - likely chunkSystem is also undefined.Since we can't pass all the dependencies, maybe we need a different approach - stub out the entire WorldTick constructor with defaults for all dependencies.

Or better - use node with --import flag to pre-load and fix up the WorldTick before it starts.Let me check if we can do some initialization and make the server work with minimal dependencies.
